faq.title: Questions
faq.comingSoonA: Paid plans are not on sale yet. The prices on this page are what we plan to charge, and they and the limits can still change before launch. Until then every account is on the free plan. Join the waitlist to get one email when paid plans start.
faq.byokQ: Can I use AI without a paid plan?
faq.byokA: Yes. Add a key from an OpenAI-compatible provider under Settings → AI provider. Those requests are billed by your provider, use no AI Points and are not limited by any plan. Free accounts also get a monthly allowance of AI Points.
faq.euA: Documents, files and backups are stored by OVHcloud in the EU. The AI that markoto.app pays for runs at EU providers: Mistral AI (text, voice), Jina AI (knowledge search, reading web pages), Staan (web search) and Black Forest Labs (images). With your own AI key, requests go to the provider you chose. The privacy policy lists every sub-processor.
faq.anonQ: What happens to documents I write without an account?
faq.anonA: Anyone with the link can read and edit them. They are deleted after {n} day without edits, and only the browser that created one can delete it sooner. Sign in to keep documents, make them private or lock them with a password. | Anyone with the link can read and edit them. They are deleted after {n} days without edits, and only the browser that created one can delete it sooner. Sign in to keep documents, make them private or lock them with a password.
faq.anonKeptA: Anyone with the link can read and edit them, and only the browser that created one can delete it. Sign in to make documents private or lock them with a password.
faq.selfHostQ: Can I run markoto on my own server?
faq.selfHostA: Yes. The code is source-available under the FSL-1.1 licence, which becomes Apache-2.0 after two years. A self-hosted instance has every feature and no plans: you set the limits and connect your own AI provider or a local model. The self-hosting guide in the docs covers the install.

design-doc.name: Design doc / RFC

Required disclosure under GDPR Article 13(1)(e). We notify workspace-owner customers at least 30 days in advance of any new sub-processor.

purpose.ovh_postgres: Primary application database, Y.js document state, knowledge embeddings
purpose.ovh_object_storage: Image uploads, knowledge-base originals (deleted post-processing), database backups
purpose.mistral_ai: AI text generation for the writing assistant, including the free AI allowance: open-weight and Mistral models served and processed by Mistral (currently DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, GLM-5.3 Flash and Mistral Large 4; their developers receive no data); voice transcription (Voxtral). All requests go to Mistral's EU endpoint (data centres in the EU and EFTA)
purpose.jina_ai: Embedding generation for knowledge-base RAG; single-URL page content extraction for the fetch-URL tool (Jina Reader; the URL is sent for every user, including users with their own AI provider)
purpose.staan: Web search for the AI writing assistant (the search query is sent for every user, including users with their own AI provider), via a proprietary European search index (EU-only routing)
purpose.bfl: Image generation via FLUX (EU-pinned data plane)
purpose.google_ads: Ad conversion measurement: the ad click id and time of a sign-up, no other data
purpose.google_oauth: Sign-in via Google account (no other Google data accessed)
purpose.github_oauth: Sign-in via GitHub account (no other GitHub data accessed)
purpose.stripe: Subscription billing and payment records; for purchases, Link (Stripe) is the seller and an independent controller
purpose.sentry: Application error + performance telemetry, stored in Sentry's EU (Frankfurt) data region
purpose.resend: Transactional email delivery, account-deletion confirmations, data-export-ready notifications, breach notifications
